method: Official Webby Gallery verification, current live-page review, Playwright scroll-through, revealed-state screenshot capture, and short motion recording for four strong examples.

sites.name: Grilled Pixels - Adam Roberts
sites.tone_and_confidence: Direct, energetic and craft-proud. Confidence comes from specificity and longevity, then softens through family images and an endearing early-web origin story.
sites.typography_and_layout: Oversized condensed display type, numbered editorial sections, a tight monochrome palette, and irregularly placed media create a magazine-like personal dossier.
sites.scroll_and_reveal: Long vertical sequence with section counters, scale shifts and image reveals; the page alternates dense proof with lighter human moments.
sites.pointer_touch: Hover and cursor feedback support calls to action and media; the story remains readable without them.
sites.media_simulation: Portrait and candid family photography interrupt the professional narrative; motion and WebGL capability are described and demonstrated in page behavior.
sites.why_it_works: It proves range through a coherent life story rather than a detached skills list. Specific dates, collaborators and formative detail make the confidence believable.
borrow_for_alexander: one vivid origin detail
professional proof followed by a human image interruption
numbered chapters that make a long page skimmable
avoid: the full length is far beyond a one-minute read
large service inventories repeat the portfolio
too many award metrics can feel self-congratulatory
sites.accessibility_performance: Heavy animation and custom cursor treatment increase cognitive and GPU load. Provide reduced-motion behavior and avoid making body copy depend on reveal completion.

capture.notes: Visible body text includes navigation and interface labels, so word count is an upper bound.

sites.name: Won J. You Studios - My Story
sites.scope: individual design leader, educator and coach
sites.tone_and_confidence: Warm, optimistic and deliberately characterful. Bold labels such as tech optimist and design geek give permission for personality, while the evidence stays concrete.
sites.typography_and_layout: Large kinetic type and repeated self-descriptors run through a minimalist grid; portraits and small factual paragraphs provide contrast.
sites.scroll_and_reveal: A directive to scroll begins a paced transformation from manifesto to person to proof. Text bands, image sequences and press modules create clear tempo changes.
sites.pointer_touch: Hover and tap animate media and links, but scrolling carries the narrative.
sites.media_simulation: A portrait sequence behaves like an animated contact sheet; repeated image states make one person feel lively without adding decorative subject matter.
sites.why_it_works: The page turns a career pivot into a simple story: what I did, what it taught me, and what I am here to do next.
borrow_for_alexander: state the future-facing mission early
use a short personality ticker as levity
make client proof a chapter rather than a logo wall
show teaching or community impact as an outcome
avoid: press inventory becomes repetitive
self-labels need restraint to avoid feeling manufactured
the page still exceeds the desired one-minute read
sites.accessibility_performance: The page produced many browser warnings and is very tall. Repeated animated images need lazy loading, meaningful alternatives and reduced-motion fallbacks.

capture.notes: Motion clip shows the opening narrative cadence; full capture includes all revealed sections.

sites.name: Righteous Creative

award.level: Webby Winner and People's Voice Winner

narrative_order: team portraits with humorous role labels
sites.tone_and_confidence: Dry, irreverent and anti-theatre. It sounds experienced without posturing because it names the industry behavior the founders reject.
sites.typography_and_layout: Huge stretched letterforms and a sparse black field create swagger; compact team cards and game-like class labels puncture the seriousness.
sites.scroll_and_reveal: A short single-page scroll; large typographic transitions turn five small content beats into a complete arc.
sites.pointer_touch: Portrait alternatives and subtle hover reactions add play without becoming the route through the content.
sites.media_simulation: Animated portraits and role archetypes carry most of the personality; there is no unnecessary showreel interruption.
sites.why_it_works: This is the clearest one-minute benchmark: one promise, three people, one reason for existing, one memorable cultural texture.
borrow_for_alexander: use a specific enemy or tension to explain the practice
let one playful personal reference do the work of a hobbies list
target roughly 250 to 300 core words
avoid: nostalgia can narrow the audience if overused
anti-agency language would feel borrowed unless it reflects Alexander's actual experience
sites.accessibility_performance: Very large type must preserve readable line breaks on mobile. Decorative character animations should be hidden from assistive technology.

capture.notes: The live page is effectively its own substantive About page.

sites.name: Fiddle.Digital
sites.tone_and_confidence: Poetic and earnest, with confidence located in a recurring harmony metaphor and the proof of an open-source tool.
sites.typography_and_layout: Editorial serif/sans contrast, Japanese annotations, dense but carefully measured text blocks, and audio-player UI create a distinct authored world.
sites.scroll_and_reveal: Each paragraph arrives as a discrete composition. The rhythm alternates philosophy, interaction and credential blocks rather than stacking prose.
sites.pointer_touch: The embedded player, hover details and tactile contact treatment reward exploration; all main claims remain visible in the scroll.
sites.media_simulation: Music is both interface and organizing metaphor. StringTune, the studio's own animation library, serves as a credible side-project proof point.
sites.why_it_works: The metaphor is not decoration: harmony links positioning, motion, interaction, process and the side project into one idea.
borrow_for_alexander: choose one governing metaphor for text and motion
use one self-initiated tool or experiment as proof of curiosity
alternate belief statements with playable moments
avoid: abstract belief copy can become vague
award counts should not dominate
audio needs explicit user control
sites.accessibility_performance: Autoplay audio must remain off; player controls need keyboard labels. Scroll animation should respect reduced motion.

capture.notes: Motion clip demonstrates paragraph and media pacing.

sites.name: Raw Materials - An Unusual Design Company

award.category: Professional Services & Self-Promotion and Best Navigation/Structure

narrative_order: principle that difference creates better outcomes
sites.tone_and_confidence: Provocative but reasoned. The unusual claim is immediately explained as a practical competitive principle.
sites.typography_and_layout: An experimental app-like canvas, bold color fields and modular cards avoid the conventional agency-page stack.
sites.scroll_and_reveal: Wheel input drives a virtual, spatial sequence rather than normal document flow; content behaves like connected scenes.
sites.pointer_touch: Drag, hover and directional navigation are structural, making this more interaction-led than Alexander's intended scroll-first balance.
sites.media_simulation: Work and identity live in the same spatial canvas. The interface itself is the demonstration.
sites.why_it_works: A single defensible word, unusual, organizes the proposition and interaction model.
borrow_for_alexander: name one principle and make every reveal reinforce it
treat images and experiments as connected scenes
let the interface demonstrate the stated specialty
avoid: do not copy the nonstandard navigation
a studio manifesto does not map directly to a personal biography
virtual scrolling complicates accessibility and capture
sites.accessibility_performance: The fixed virtual canvas obscures normal document height and can challenge keyboard, screen-reader and reduced-motion users. A semantic parallel flow is essential.

capture.notes: The site uses a fixed virtual canvas; ten consecutive wheel-driven viewport states were stitched so content is visible. Browser text count included hidden application content and was not used.

sites.name: Lusion - About Us
sites.scope: six-person creative production studio; small-studio mismatch

award.category: Best Mobile Visual Design - Aesthetic; Professional Services & Self-Promotion

sites.tone_and_confidence: Precise, global and production-minded. Short declarative statements let the visual craft provide most of the confidence.
sites.typography_and_layout: Enormous all-caps statements, disciplined white space and small data-like labels produce a cinematic but legible contrast.
sites.scroll_and_reveal: Virtual scrolling choreographs type, 3D and lists as large scenes. Expandable expertise restores user control after the cinematic opening.
sites.pointer_touch: Accordion-like capability controls and 3D reactions are secondary to wheel/touch scrolling.
sites.media_simulation: 3D forms are used as connective tissue, not separate portfolio pieces; motion demonstrates the studio's production specialty.
sites.why_it_works: The copy is short enough that sophisticated motion never competes with a dense biography.
borrow_for_alexander: use one spatial dot/point-cloud system as connective tissue
keep scene copy to one thought
pair expressive scenes with compact factual lists
avoid: studio capability grids are too broad for a personal page
award totals risk becoming the emotional climax
virtual scroll should not replace native scroll
sites.accessibility_performance: 3D and fixed-canvas behavior require a reduced-motion and low-power mode. Accordions need explicit states and keyboard support.

capture.notes: Ten wheel-driven states were stitched because the smooth-scroll canvas reports one viewport of document height.

sites.name: Locomotive - Agency
sites.tone_and_confidence: Playful, technically literate and civic. Montréal identity and a Triforce metaphor make the operating model memorable.
sites.typography_and_layout: Big clean type is disrupted by emoji-like symbols, counters and label fragments; the page feels systematic without becoming corporate.
sites.scroll_and_reveal: Native vertical chapters alternate manifesto, capability and team density. The embedded film is optional rather than a gate.
sites.pointer_touch: Team entries expand for biographies; the expandable layer is additive, which maps well to tap interaction.
sites.media_simulation: A short manifesto film provides a richer layer without replacing the written summary.
sites.why_it_works: The Triforce reduces operations, design and development into an understandable personal mythology.
borrow_for_alexander: compress overlapping specialties into a simple three-part model
let taps expand optional detail
use place as texture only if it explains the practice
avoid: large team and awards sections are not relevant to an individual
symbols must not create reading noise
sites.accessibility_performance: Symbol-heavy labels need clear accessible names. Optional video requires captions and pause controls.

capture.notes: Team expansions were left closed to represent the default one-pass reading experience.

sites.name: Someoddpilot - About
sites.tone_and_confidence: Culturally fluent, candid and slightly rebellious. The language rejects marketing gloss while remaining generous toward collaborators.
sites.typography_and_layout: Large manifesto typography, black-and-white imagery and alternating grids produce a zine/editorial cadence.
sites.scroll_and_reveal: The page shifts rhythm every few screens: story, principles, facts, quotes, portraits, side projects. This prevents a long page from feeling like one essay.
sites.pointer_touch: Hover reveals and linked side ventures invite detours, but the main story reads linearly.
sites.media_simulation: Photography, record-label history, an art gallery and apparel work prove cultural interests without a conventional hobbies section.
sites.why_it_works: Side projects are presented as evidence of a worldview and business evolution, never as random decoration.
borrow_for_alexander: frame small projects as evidence of taste
alternate a belief with a concrete fact
end with one unexpected side-world
use client voice sparingly to validate tone
avoid: the full leadership roster is too long
many manifesto statements compete for attention
individual copy should use I rather than imported studio we language
sites.accessibility_performance: Long animated pages need landmarks and skip links. Image-heavy blocks should use responsive assets and meaningful alt text.

capture.notes: Default biography and side-venture states are visible; linked sub-sites were not followed.

sites.name: Better Off Studio - The Lookback
narrative_order: why looking back clarifies the future
monthly index of work, music, inspiration and clients
sites.tone_and_confidence: Self-aware, culturally alert and lightly boastful with a wink. It admits that the archive is a flex, then explains why reflection is useful.
sites.typography_and_layout: Oversized date and archive typography, black fields and index labels turn an annual recap into an editorial object.
sites.scroll_and_reveal: A fixed virtual-scroller moves from declaration into a month-by-month archive. The index structure gives side material an organizing reason.
sites.pointer_touch: Music and archive items are browsable, while the About statement remains the linear entry point.
sites.media_simulation: Playlists, inspiration, client moments and case studies share one time-based system; taste becomes part of professional identity.
sites.why_it_works: It offers the best answer to how side projects can be sprinkled in: bind them to time, influence or a recurring theme.
borrow_for_alexander: package posters and experiments as a small cabinet of current obsessions
make levity a final recurring archive beat
connect looking back to future aspiration
avoid: a calendar archive would overwhelm a one-minute About page
do not expose unfinished filler months
music autoplay would be intrusive
sites.accessibility_performance: Fixed virtual scrolling and background audio need strong fallbacks. Every archive item should be reachable by keyboard and represented in semantic order.

capture.notes: Ten wheel-driven states were stitched because the app uses a fixed virtual canvas. This page is an About/annual taste archive attached to the nominated studio site.

sites.name: Metalab - About
sites.scope: global product design firm; large-team mismatch
sites.tone_and_confidence: Friendly, factual and employee-led. The firm lets named people and measurable practices carry the claims.
sites.typography_and_layout: Large conversational headings, horizontal place names, portrait grids and compact metrics create a human data-story.
sites.scroll_and_reveal: A restrained vertical sequence moves from global scale to individual voices to quantified culture.
sites.pointer_touch: Drag and hover are explicitly signposted on image and location modules, adding play without hiding the text.
sites.media_simulation: Remote-work portraits and desk photographs make an abstract distributed team tangible.
sites.why_it_works: Claims such as autonomy and balance are immediately followed by employee testimony and policies.
borrow_for_alexander: follow each belief with evidence
use a few client or collaborator voices instead of self-praise
turn trajectory into named places or environments only when meaningful
avoid: employment metrics are irrelevant to a personal site
generic culture claims without proof
drag cues should not distract from scroll
sites.accessibility_performance: Draggable visuals need non-drag alternatives. Diversity metrics require context rather than purely visual presentation.

capture.notes: Current live page is recruitment-oriented; principles were extracted for individual-profile use and the scale mismatch is explicit.

sites.name: Dops Agency
sites.tone_and_confidence: Polished, enthusiastic and client-centered. Repeated references to user desire keep the language outward-facing rather than autobiographical.
sites.typography_and_layout: Large staggered statements, glowing imagery and modular work cards create a high-energy studio showcase.
sites.scroll_and_reveal: A long home/About hybrid alternates proof and explanation; testimonial typography provides useful tempo changes.
sites.pointer_touch: Hover states animate project previews and service labels; scroll retains control.
sites.media_simulation: 3D motion and animated case media demonstrate capability, though they are more portfolio than biography.
sites.why_it_works: The page does not merely say passionate or visionary; it places those values beside work, testimonials and client numbers.
borrow_for_alexander: keep confidence outward-facing by describing client or user benefit
use one short testimonial as a change of voice
pair each specialty with a visual proof fragment
avoid: adjectives such as visionary become generic when repeated
logo and award walls are too corporate
do not duplicate the Portfolio route
sites.accessibility_performance: Animated media and luminous contrast need reduced-motion testing and accessible text contrast. Dense project grids require clear focus states.

capture.notes: The substantive About content is integrated into the one-page studio home.

sites.name: AW Portfolio - Antoine Wodniack
sites.tone_and_confidence: Extremely concise and matter-of-fact. A single chronological sentence covers tools, roles, projects, leadership and ongoing learning.
sites.typography_and_layout: A saturated red field, giant condensed type, binary texture and geometric WebGL/canvas forms turn minimal copy into a strong authored environment.
sites.scroll_and_reveal: The native scroll moves through pinned typographic and geometric scenes. Text is sparse enough to be read while the spatial composition changes.
sites.pointer_touch: Contrast control and geometric reactions add agency; the biography itself requires no interaction.
sites.media_simulation: Abstract grids and forms visualize coding and motion without showing generic code screenshots.
sites.why_it_works: This is the best word-count benchmark. The career sentence is dense with evidence, while the page behavior supplies excitement.
borrow_for_alexander: compress trajectory into one vivid sentence
let the visual system carry emotion so copy can stay short
state availability or aspiration plainly
use abstract dot geometry instead of illustrative filler
avoid: an awards-only proof section can feel narrow
extreme color and condensed type reduce long-form readability
pinned scenes must not create blank scroll regions
sites.accessibility_performance: High saturation and condensed display type need contrast and readability checks. Canvas decoration should be ignored by assistive technology and disabled for reduced motion.

capture.notes: Twelve viewport states were stitched because one full-page capture left blank areas around pinned scenes. Word count excludes decorative binary digits.

sites.name: Mark Woodland
narrative_order: three initiatives linked to human outcomes
sites.tone_and_confidence: Purposeful, civic and controlled. Confidence comes from connecting every venture to a human outcome, not from describing the founder as exceptional.
sites.typography_and_layout: Oversized editorial typography, periwinkle/blue color fields, rounded media and numbered policy chapters create a contemporary public-leadership profile.
sites.scroll_and_reveal: Vertical scroll is the backbone; pinned topic transitions and optional video deepen the story. Repeated keep-scrolling cues sustain momentum.
sites.pointer_touch: Users can choose housing, education or healthcare and play short takes. These interactions expand a clear default narrative.
sites.media_simulation: Founder video is divided by topic, avoiding a single long showreel. Venture cards connect abstract beliefs to real systems.
sites.why_it_works: The page converts a complicated multi-industry career into one belief, three proof points and three optional deeper topics.
borrow_for_alexander: use one belief as the spine
group clients and projects by the change Alexander helps create
offer optional tap-to-expand stories
end on an outward-looking aspiration
avoid: repeated issue copy pushes beyond one minute
video errors or missing captions damage credibility
public-leadership gravitas should not displace playfulness
sites.accessibility_performance: Observed browser console errors around media did not prevent the text capture but are a risk. Videos require captions, poster fallbacks and reduced-motion-safe transitions.

capture.notes: Full page captured; optional topic videos were not opened so the default reading path remains visible.
